reference_sql:
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, end_date,
       MAX(end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS channel_last_end
FROM campaigns
alternatives:
WITH channel_end AS (  -- one row per channel with campaigns
  SELECT channel_id, MAX(end_date) AS last_end
  FROM campaigns
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.end_date, ce.last_end AS channel_last_end
FROM campaigns c
JOIN channel_end ce ON ce.channel_id = c.channel_id

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.end_date,
       (SELECT MAX(c2.end_date) FROM campaigns c2 WHERE c2.channel_id = c.channel_id) AS channel_last_end
FROM campaigns c

other_way.sql:
WITH channel_end AS (  -- one row per channel with campaigns
  SELECT channel_id, MAX(end_date) AS last_end
  FROM campaigns
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, c.end_date, ce.last_end AS channel_last_end
FROM campaigns c
JOIN channel_end ce ON ce.channel_id = c.channel_id
other_way.tradeoff: A per-channel step with the latest date, joined back, works on any engine, but adds a step and a join.
